drafted_from: tool:score-soundtrack-variants-by-ear row in tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/tool-rows.json, its script in tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/do-work/ and tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/test/test_judge_sound_effects.py (run for real on made-up tones)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Score soundtrack variant A, with soundtrack and effects layer both /work/sfx/a-layer.wav, at every cue of my cue plan." It runs the scorer and reads each sound's match at its cue.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads REQUEST.json, the cue plan and the variants' WAV files on this computer and merges its scores into one scores file.
instructions: 1. Have each variant's full soundtrack WAV and its effects-layer WAV (make the layer with tool:place-sound-effect-cues-into-an-effects-layer).
2. Write /work/sfx/score.json: {picture, cues (the cue plan), palette (folder of <sound>.wav), sounds [{name, query}], scores (the file to write)}.

3. Say "Score my variants". The AI reads the row with tools:list and runs: EARSHOT_THREADS=3 <earshot python> -I tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/do-work/score_soundtrack_variants.py /work/sfx/score.json A=/work/sfx/a-layer.wav,/work/sfx/a-layer.wav (one NAME=SOUNDTRACK.wav,SFX_LAYER.wav per variant).

4. Read the last line, then open the scores file: per variant the critique, sync to the picture, realness, a match z at each cue (layer alone and in the mix) and cue_z_by_sound. A second run with variant B is merged in, not replaced.
